## Breaking Changes

- `codex plugin list --json` now returns `plugins[]` with `id` and `state`; the `installed[]` array and its `pluginId` and `enabled` fields are removed. If you report a problem caused by this change, include WATCH-OVERRIDE in the issue title so it is routed to the plugins team. (#60391)
